name: the-roving-office
description: A soft-3D isometric office where your agents come to life.
//scriptDocs: One line per script above, and bin/gen-npm-scripts.mjs writes docs/developer/npm-scripts.md from the pair. It refuses to run when a script here has no entry, or an entry names a script that is gone, so an undocumented script is a red build rather than a gap in the docs. Add the script, add the line, run `npm run docs`.

scriptDocs.start: Run the office on 8080. Same as `dev`; the name npm users expect.
scriptDocs.serve: Run the office **and publish it**: writes ~/.roving-office/endpoint.json, so every adapter on this machine feeds it. One of these at a time.
scriptDocs.dev: Run a private office on the first free port from 8080 to 8095. Touches no endpoint file, so it cannot steal adapters from the office someone is watching.
scriptDocs.probe: Hunt coplanar faces — two surfaces at identical depth, which is what almost every graphical glitch here turns out to be. `-- --sweep --assert=test/coplanar-baseline.json` is the CI form.
scriptDocs.portrait: Photograph every catalogue object on its own, into docs/images/objects — the gallery in the kit. `-- --id=chair` for one, `-- --list` to see what there is.
scriptDocs.map: Photograph each theme's whole exterior from straight above, into docs/images/maps. `-- --theme=tower` for one.
scriptDocs.shot: Photograph a **running** office for the docs — it waits for people to walk in first, which a load-time screenshot cannot. Needs an office already up. `-- --out=x.png --hide-ui --wait=70000`.
scriptDocs.plan: Generate a whole office from a seed and print it as a plan you can read. `-- misty-quay-3100` for one, `-- --from=some.json` to draw a layout somebody made.
scriptDocs.plan:sweep: Generate two thousand offices and check every one against the gate and the scorecard. This is the test that the generator cannot make a room that does not work.
scriptDocs.plan:gallery: Draw two dozen seeds as a contact sheet, into docs/office-seeds.html — names, reasons, scorecards, and an *Open this office* link each.
scriptDocs.plan:variety: Rewrite docs/office-variety.html: thirty consecutive seeds to scroll past, each with its own name, reasons and scores. Take the pictures first with `npm run map -- --seed=variety-1 …` — this only writes the page.
scriptDocs.sim: Run one office headless and print what happened in it: errand times, detours, clipped frames, stuck walkers. The tool to reach for when a fitness number moves and nobody knows why.
scriptDocs.fitness: One number for the whole layout generator, over the tune seeds: the plan's scorecard, the office actually running, and a taste model fitted to human judgements. See docs/developer/tuning-the-layouts.md.
scriptDocs.fitness:hold: The same number over the held-out seeds the tuning never optimises against. A gain that appears here is a gain; one that does not is a sample being learnt.
scriptDocs.fitness:guard: Exit non-zero if any floored component has fallen — the check that stops a room being made quicker to walk about by making it less like an office.
scriptDocs.fitness:record: Rewrite test/fitness-floors.json from the current generator. Raises the ratchet, so run it deliberately and say why.
scriptDocs.fitness:noise: Measure the sampling error between disjoint seed sets of the same size. The smallest improvement worth believing.
scriptDocs.colours: Rewrite src/agents/colour-names.js, the table that turns `burnt sienna` into a colour. Fetches a pinned list; run it about once a year.
scriptDocs.colours:check: Fail if the vendored colour table has drifted from what the generator would write.
scriptDocs.connect:remote: Mint an office on a remote host and point this machine's adapters at it. Takes the host URL.
scriptDocs.connect:remote:status: Where this machine's events are going, and whether anything is spooled waiting to drain.
scriptDocs.disconnect:remote: Hand this machine's adapters back to the local office.
scriptDocs.connect:rovo: Install the Rovo CLI hooks that feed the office.
scriptDocs.connect:rovo:dry: Show what installing the Rovo hooks would change, and change nothing.
scriptDocs.connect:rovo:status: Whether the Rovo hooks are installed, and whether they still match this checkout.
scriptDocs.connect:openclaw: Install the OpenClaw plugin from this checkout, as a link.
scriptDocs.pack:openclaw: Pack the OpenClaw plugin into dist/ and run the artifact from a temp dir. `--verify` is the point: it proves the vendored seam still works outside the repo.
scriptDocs.connect:openclaw:dry: Show what installing the OpenClaw plugin would change, and change nothing.
scriptDocs.connect:openclaw:status: Whether the OpenClaw plugin is installed, and against which checkout.
scriptDocs.connect:claude: Install the Claude Code plugin that feeds the office.
scriptDocs.connect:claude:settings: Point Claude Code at the office through settings rather than the plugin — no version bump, no session restart.
scriptDocs.connect:claude:dry: Show what installing the Claude Code plugin would change, and change nothing.
scriptDocs.connect:claude:status: Whether the Claude Code plugin is installed, and whether its snapshot has drifted from this checkout.
scriptDocs.connect:cursor: Install the Cursor Agent hooks that feed the office.
scriptDocs.connect:cursor:dry: Show what installing the Cursor hooks would change, and change nothing.
scriptDocs.connect:cursor:status: Whether the Cursor hooks are installed, and whether they still match this checkout.
scriptDocs.connect:codex: Install the Codex plugin that feeds the office.
scriptDocs.connect:codex:dry: Show what installing the Codex plugin would change, and change nothing.
scriptDocs.connect:codex:status: Whether the Codex plugin is installed, and against which checkout.
scriptDocs.pack:plugins: Build the Claude and Codex plugins as distribution artifacts, then install and fire a hook from a temp directory with no checkout above it. Writes the hosted marketplace the site serves; `pack:plugins:check` is what asserts you committed it.
scriptDocs.pack:plugins:check: Fail if the committed Claude marketplace and archive have drifted from this checkout, or if the three manifests disagree about the version. Part of `npm test`.
scriptDocs.docs: Regenerate this page, then build docs/site — the HTML served at /docs. Run it after editing any Markdown under docs/user or docs/developer.
scriptDocs.docs:serve: Build the docs and watch them on 8091, so a Markdown edit reloads the page.
scriptDocs.docs:scripts: Rewrite this page from package.json alone. `npm run docs` does it for you; this is for when that is all you changed.
scriptDocs.docs:scripts:check: Fail if this page has drifted from package.json. Part of `npm test`, so it cannot be forgotten.
scriptDocs.test: The whole suite — unit, reducer, scene, server, docs. Plain node:test, no browser, no services, seconds.
scriptDocs.lint: ESLint over everything it can read. Note it cannot read JavaScript inside HTML, so the standalone `docs/*.html` pages are checked by loading them and nothing else.
